description: Share files and clipboard to devices nearby you Share files and clipboard to devices nearby you. Get a high-speed transfer, without using the internet, with a lightweight application. The 2 devices don't need to be on the same network. No QR code to scan. Alternative to AirDrop, Nearby Share and Quick Share based on Wi-Fi Aware. Warning: A future release may break compatibility with earlier versions, specially if it is required to get iOS support.
